elements.description: Open decisions with two quick answers each; answered ones confirm, then fold away.

properties.name: decisions
properties.description: The decisions to show – new ones join as they're passed, answered ones fold away

properties.name: answers
properties.description:
The answers given so far, by decision id. Answers present on first render start folded away. Changed by the
user unless a tc-answers-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: decide
properties.type: ((decision: InboxDecision, answer: DecisionAnswer) => void | Promise<unknown>) | undefined
properties.description: Called with the decision and the chosen answer. Return a promise to hold the row until it settles

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-answers-change
events.description: An answer was given ({ answers }: DecisionAnswersChange, every answer by decision id); cancelable

events.name: tc-decide
events.description: A decision was answered ({ decision, answer }), after `decide` settled

props.name: answers
props.description: The answers given so far, by decision id. Controlled when defined – pair it with `onAnswersChange`

props.name: defaultAnswers
props.description: Answers already given on mount when `answers` isn't controlled – those rows start folded away

props.name: onAnswersChange
props.description: Called with every answer, controlled or not

props.name: onDecide
props.description:
Called with the decision and the chosen answer. Return a promise to hold the row until it settles: it answers on
success, and on a rejection says so and offers both buttons again
